notes.title: Update 2.2 Is Out Now!
notes.notes: The big animated board update is officially out now! Read up on all of the changes over in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/3247565033759284935/]forums[/url] and don't forget to check out the new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-wqtZGTPT3w]trailer![/url]

notes.title: Update 2.2 Feature Complete
notes.notes:
Update 2.2 is almost here and we've got a feature complete version available now for testing in the beta channel. The new release includes animated board updates to the 2 Anniversary sets plus a handful of new features. Read the details over in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1836811737980972315/]forums.[/url]

New HD powerup icons plus improved scripting support and bug fixes in the latest beta for the upcoming 2.2 release. Read about the changes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1796278072830367044/]here[/url].

notes.title: Update 2.2 Beta Available Now
notes.notes:
We've hit the first big milestone in our giant dynamic board update. The beta for version 2.2 is now available with new custom game modes and some major editor updates. New dynamic board content will be coming soon! For more details see our update in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/3247562523074758646/]forums[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/866e2b45919df7c1a85fcf4c8ffbb7e4cfae8bbc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.1 and DLC + Season Pass Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Version 2.1 is officialy out now with saved games, gravity push/pull, difficulty modes, scoring changes, editor improvements and more. Read all of the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1742229167183882353/]here[/url].

The re-mastered version of Board Pack 2 is almost done and will be available for sale in a few days. We'll also be releasing a DX-Ball 2 Season Pass which will get you all 4 remaining board packs for one low price, plus a Deluxe Anniversary Version for new players that includes the base game and the Season Pass.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/7bef374da598b550210c9e98a65b40518c85ae35.gif[/img]

notes.title: Testing New Update
notes.notes:
The first [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1743353798888414300/]big update[/url] for DX-Ball 2 is now available for testing in the beta branch. This version adds a ton of requested features including saved games, gravity push/pull, new difficulty modes, scoring adjustments and volume controls.

As we wrap up this update, we're getting back to working on some new content so stay tuned for board pack announcements soon.

And for a little nostalgia, yesterday officially marked 20 years since game's launch and thanks to the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/19990427084228/http://www.longbowdigitalarts.com:80/dxball2.html]Wayback Machine[/url] you can still browse around the original page and even link through to some of the first reviews.

And for fans of the soundtrack, original DX-Ball composer Sidewinder has just published brand new versions of the game's most iconic tracks which you can stream now on [url=https://t.co/kKSArFxlzq]YouTube.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/85179bb43d6f2844fe36a78b294c36fc1dd0e411.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First DX-Ball 2 Update & Beta Editor
notes.notes:
The first game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1742226629878515789/]update[/url] for DX-Ball is out now with a couple fixes for mouse constraints and ball speed, and we've got a new board editor out in beta with lots of new features including Undo/Redo, Fill tool, animated bricks and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/ef74558cf052becb81769e9145fdadde94c3fe64.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DX-Ball 2 DLC and Update Roadmap
notes.notes: With the game launched and first update available now in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1742226629861425290/]beta[/url], check out our new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1742226629863277481]update roadmap[/url] to see some of the exciting new content, features and engine upgrades that we're working on. And don't forget to check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/workshop/]workshop[/url] for lots of great new community-created content that's ready to play right now.
